connector.name: EdgarParser MCP
connector.registryDescription: MCP stdio server for source-backed SEC EDGAR financial data from the hosted EdgarParser API.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package edgar-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the henrysouchien account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: EDGAR_API_KEY
env.description: API key for the hosted EdgarParser API.

env.name: EDGAR_API_URL
env.description: Optional API base URL override. Defaults to https://www.edgarparser.com.
